pages.text: This module adds client-side features that do not require Quark to be loaded on the server.

pages.title: Shulker Boxes
pages.text: Hovering over a shulker box displays its contents.

pages.title: Chest Search
pages.text: When using search, all non-matching items will be dimmed.

pages.title: Enchanted Book Icons
pages.text: Icons show which items the enchanted book applies to.

pages.title: Food Tooltip
pages.text: Each food item displays how much hunger and saturation it restores.

pages.title: Despawn Flashing
pages.text: 10 seconds before despawning, dropped items will begin to flash.

pages.title: Map Tooltip
pages.text: Hovering your cursor over a map allows you to preview it.

pages.title: Slot Highlighting
pages.text: When hovering, you will see slots where the item cannot be used.
